title: [Control Systems] Siemens security advisory (AV26-864)
description: As of August 27, 2026, Siemens is affected by a vulnerability in the following products:
products:
Element maps-ng V47
	Prior to V47.12.3

Element maps-ng V48
	Prior to V48.11.3

Element maps-ng V49
	Prior to V49.16.1
solution: Review the references and apply the necessary updates.
